Comments (English): After giving birth, my wrists are about to go out, so I can't do the dishes, but if my husband asks me to, I can't stand it and fight. Then, I got a dishwasher as a tester and I can't tell you how happy I am. Unlike the existing 6-person dishwasher, this product is for 3 people, so it's small. So it doesn't take up much space, so it can be used in a studio apartment. In addition, since it's a product that you have to install yourself without an installer, if you buy it, there's no shipping cost burden and it's cheap. Which one should I buy, the 6-person or the 3-person? After all, people with small families or people who live alone tend to prefer small capacities over large capacities. However, since the washing time is the same no matter how small it is, if you're a single-person household that doesn't do a lot of dishes, I recommend the cost-effective 3-person rather than the expensive 6-person. And even if you're a 2-3 person household, if you cook often or have a lot of dishes, I recommend the 6-person. Is it noisy? Usually, when you look at other companies' products, they're noisy, but this product is quiet because it's designed to be low-noise. Of course, the feeling may vary from person to person, but please note that it is quieter than other companies. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (Original): 아이 낳고 손목이 나갈거 같아서 설거지까지는 무리인데 남편 시키면 성에 안차서 싸우기 일 수.... 그러다 체험단으로 식기세척기 겟하게 되서 얼마나 기쁜지 몰라요 ㅎㅎ  이 제품은 기존 6인용 식기세척기와 다르게 3인용이라서 크기가 작아요. 그래서 공간차지를 많이 안해서 원룸에서도 충분히 사용가능하답니다. 게다가 설치기사 없이 직접 설치해야되는 상품이라 구매를 하게 된다면 배송비 부담도 없고 저렴한 편이에요.  6인용이랑 3인용 중 어떤걸 사야할까요? 아무래도 가족수가 적거나 혼자 사시는 분들은 큰 용량보다는 작은 용량을 선호하시는 경우가 많아요. 하지만 아무리 작아도 세척시간은 동일하기 때문에 설거지 양이 많지 않은 1인가구라면 굳이 비싼 6인용 보다는 가성비 좋은 3인용을 추천드려요. 그리고 2~3인 가구라도 요리를 자주하거나 그릇양이 많다면 6인용을 추천드립니다.  소음이 심한가요? 보통 다른 회사 제품들을 보면 소음이 심한경우가 많은데 해당 제품은 저소음 설계라서 조용한편이래요. 물론 사람마다 느끼는 차이는 있겠지만 타사 대비 조용한 편이니 참고하세요. 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Sentence (English): What more needs to be said?
Comments (English): [ Welcome the kitchen lady~ ] || ---------------- || What more needs to be said? It’s the kitchen lady’s masterpiece! It’s the Samsung Bespoke Dishwasher. The color is light pink, too. It brightens up the kitchen and looks so pretty. Reason for purchase: We are a family of five raising three children. So, there are a lot of dishes to wash after every meal. Still, washing dishes wasn't difficult for me. However, our youngest kept asking if Mom hated him, saying I wouldn't play with him and didn't understand his feelings. Since we both work, I don't really have time to play with him on weekdays. So, I bought this to increase the time I spend playing with my 4-year-old youngest, even if it means cutting down on dishwashing time. User Review: First off, after using it, in a word... I wondered why I hadn't bought this sooner. Honestly, since I’m quick with my hands, I thought I could just wash the dishes right away. But after actually using it, it’s so convenient and great. It saves a lot of time, too. I prefer washing dishes immediately, so I think I made the right choice buying the 6-place setting. At first, I didn't like having it on the countertop, but since the color and design are pretty, it doesn't really bother me, and the kitchen looks quite neat. Also, since it sits on the countertop, I don't need to bend over to place dishes, making the workflow convenient. And because it's a 6-place setting, it's convenient to run it right after meals without having to gather the dishes beforehand. It takes 1 hour and 16 minutes on the standard setting. Once it's finished, the door opens automatically to let the heat dissipate, and it's even better that it comes out dry. When I touch the dishes after it's done, they feel warm from the heat; it feels like they're being disinfected, which is a nice feeling. I even tried washing a tumbler, and it seems the water stream reaches the very bottom of the bottle, judging by the water droplets. Since I wipe down the sink and stovetop while the dishwasher is running, it has really shortened the time I spend organizing the kitchen. I get to spend more time with my youngest during that time, and I can relax while drinking tea. Words can't describe it. For those of you who were hesitating like me, it's a waste of time to even think about it. Just buy it now! Pros: Clean washing, sterilization with heat, and perfect drying. Cons: The downside of the machine is that hard rice grains don't come off easily. Also, if there is a lot of red grease on it, sometimes it comes off well, and other times it doesn't. There were instances where a little bit remained on the surface. I guess I put it in the wrong place. Also, I use EcoVore All-in-One detergent. Since this is a 6-place setting model, putting in a whole bottle is too much, so I have to split it into quarters. Splitting this detergent is really difficult because it's hard, too. Comments (English): [ After installation, make sure to test run the unit before the technician leaves! ] || ---------------- || First off, the price seems to hover around 340,000 won. Also, be sure to touch the sink valve with your hand to check for any leaks. The technician installed it and left, but water was dripping one drop at a time under the sink, so I tightened the valve securely again. With high hopes, I neatly stacked the evening dishes and pressed the start button... but a 4C error appeared. I opened the water supply valve (meaning the technician had closed it before leaving, implying they hadn't done a test run). When I tried operating it again, this time it was an LC error. Water was leaking because the water inlet valve at the back of the unit wasn't tightly closed. Even after tightening it securely to stop the leak, it still wouldn't work due to the error. I looked through various reviews and saw posts saying the technician had come and cleaned the leak sensor. So, I laid a towel on the floor. By morning, the moisture had all been absorbed by the towel. I decided to try operating it one more time before the technician arrived, just in case, and thankfully, it worked fine again. I contacted the technician again to ask them not to come. Phew. None of this would have happened if the technician had installed it correctly and run a test run just once. I honestly struggled with the dishwasher all afternoon; it was so exhausting. -------. Review after using it for a few days. It's fantastic. It cleans grease off the dishes perfectly, leaving them squeaky clean. The automatic door opening is the best. The dishes stay warm and dry quickly, so there are no water stains. Thank you. Highly recommended. I've forgotten all the trouble I went through during the installation.

Sentence (English): This LG STUDIO Model SDWB24S3 does a nice job getting dishes clean, and I really like the lighted interior.
Comments (English): [ Lighted interior! ] || ---------------- || This LG STUDIO Model SDWB24S3 does a nice job getting dishes clean, and I really like the lighted interior. It's pretty quiet, and even a bit quieter with the sound insulation kit installed. Without the sound kit the maximum loudness was 50 dB. With the sound kit it was a bit quieter - I measured the quietest at 40 dB. The sound kit is to be installed after the first cycle has been run. It tucks under the door, making the door harder to open all the way. The instructions that came with the kit are difficult to understand, but searching online for "lg sound insulation" came up with two helpful videos. The lower rack has great ball bearings and wants to glide on its own, so making sure the door is all the way open is important. My previous top-control dishwasher fit flush with the cabinets had the same depth handle so I assumed that the new LG handle would also clear the drawer that opens across the front of the dishwasher. During install we discovered that the dishwasher 24 5/8" deep, so it will always protrude beyond the cabinets given a standard 24" deep dishwasher cutout. Now the dishwasher door has to be partially opened before the drawer can be opened. The increased depth also required the use of the side screws, since the top brackets were too far forward to match the countertop. Connecting to the ThinQ app worked smoothly. When I started the first cycle Dry Boost was on. In order to turn it off I had to cancel the cycle, drain tub, and refill in order to change that setting. On auto the cycle time is 2 hours 34 minutes. There's a "rinse aid" light the blinked because I hadn't added any. I don't normally use rinse aid, but the instructions said that using it would reduce the remaining water on the dishes after the cycle, and sure enough it really does help - no water drops at the bottoms of the plates and bowls when I take them out. After pressing "start", the display shows a 4 second countdown to close the door. The bottom rack has large 2" square openings, so some of my glasses won't stand up there. When loading the upper rack I like to load bowls in the tines and glasses along the outside edges. This LG has narrower "alleys" at the outer edges than my previous dishwasher so the same glasses and mugs now push the bowls towards the inside. I take care when adjusting the upper rack. It has 3 positions about an inch apart, top, middle, and bottom. It's possible to latch the rack in the middle on one side and the bottom on the other, in which case the door has difficulty closing because of the misalignment.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher because of its technology and because in theory it is a good brand.
Comments (English): [ Terrible dishwasher and technical service ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher because of its technology and because in theory it is a good brand. Well, it's been a year and a little since I bought it and it has already broken. The technical service came and looked at it and took it away. After 3 days, they tell me that if they fix it I have to pay 360 euros, because it broke due to poor maintenance and is not covered by warranty. They send photos and it turns out that the filter and the walls below were clean, because that's what everyone does and that's what it says in the maintenance book. Well, it turns out that they have dismantled the blades and unscrewed the entire base (I don't know anyone who has ever done that) and there were remains of food (something that neither we nor the technician who came to look at it could see). I have contacted LG and they do not want to know anything about the issue. So I have to buy another dishwasher, although I no longer plan to buy anything from this brand.

Al cabo de 3 días, me dicen que si lo arreglan tengo que pagar 360 euros, porque se ha roto por mal mantenimiento y no entra en garantía. Mandan fotos y resulta que el filtro y las paredes de abajo estaban limpias, porque es lo que todo el mundo hace y es lo que pone en el libro de mantenimiento. Pues resulta que ellos han desmontado las aspas y destornillado toda la base (no conozco ha nadie que haya hecho eso nunca) y había restos de comida (cosa que ni nosotros, ni el técnico que vino a mirársela supo ver). Me he puesto en contacto con LG y ellos no quieren saber nada del tema. Así que me toca comprar otro lavavajillas, aunque ya no pienso comprar nada de esta marca.

Sentence (English): Great working dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great working dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Great working dishwasher. Had this item delivered and installed. Delivery communication was spot on and the installer was very professional and helpful. This washer works great. The only complaint I have is the time it takes to complete a full cycle. Our old dishwasher took about 45mins to an hour. This one takes 2.5 to 3.5hrs depending on the setting you choose. Also noticed that once it's completed the inside stays wet as well as the dishes. I've fixed this by putting a rolled up dish cloth in between the door so the hot air can escape and the dishes finish drying. We've even left them in there over night before trying the fix and they would still be wet. But again, I love it. Could it be better, of course. But that goes with almost anything you by now days.

Sentence (English): We had a 10 year old dishwasher that worked relatively well but was an inexpensive builder special from a new-build house.
Comments (English): [ Great value for quality ] || ---------------- || We had a 10 year old dishwasher that worked relatively well but was an inexpensive builder special from a new-build house. It finally stopped heating properly so we replaced it with this Whirlpool Dishwasher. It is amazing! I love everything including the closing mechanism on the door which seamlessly shuts with little pressure. The display and buttons are very intuitive and I like the different options. There is a steam release valve on the front which helps with the drying cycle. Almost everything comes out dry except where water can pool (like in the bottom of coffee mugs). It is also extremely quiet. We used to have to run our dishwasher when we were out of the room. We have an open living/kitchen so that basically meant we had to remember before we went to bed. This dishwasher is so quiet we can run it any time. It's a huge quality of life improvement. I'd recommend this to anyone!

Sentence (English): First, I want to start by saying that this dishwasher is gorgeous compared to other dishwashers we have seen.
Comments (English): [ Can't ask for too much more! ] || ---------------- || First, I want to start by saying that this dishwasher is gorgeous compared to other dishwashers we have seen. It's sleek, the buttons are placed well and the stainless steel has been holding up really well. Our only complaint about the design is how bright the timer is with no option to dim. If you walk into your kitchen at night, and the dishwasher is on, the light is so piercing that its uncomfortable.This dishwasher performs extremely well for us! We do use the temp boost for every wash, because if not we sometimes get a bit of food residue. The silverware jets are a GAME CHANGER. Every single time the silverware is always spotless! The bottle jets have proven useful with our children's aluminum bottles, especially when they drink milk. It gets even the dirtiest bottles clean.What really brings this dishwasher down a star is that we basically have to run it with everything on high, to get a spotless total wash. We were hoping to save on energy and water by running it on some of the lower settings, but for our family of 6, it's just not possible.Overall, this is the absolute best dishwasher we have ever owned. I recommend it to anyone looking to upgrade, if it's in your budget.

Sentence (English): I think it's worth the price.
Comments (English): [ It's a revolution to be free from the dishwashing! But ] || ---------------- || I think it's worth the price. The installer was friendly and there were no problems. It's Jeju Island. First of all, the installer told me to use only all-in-one solid detergent that contains both rinse and detergent. There is a rinse aid container, but I don't know why it says to only use all-in-one solid detergent. The biggest problem with this product is that I put all-in-one detergent in the detergent container, close it, and run the dishwasher. If I run it 5 times, the detergent doesn't dissolve 3 times and stays stuck to the detergent compartment. Since we are a two-person household, we don't have a lot of dishes, so I cut it in half and use it, but it's a bit bothersome. The detergent isn't completely dissolved (it feels like a little powder), but judging by the washed dishes, it seems to have been washed to some extent. However, it feels dirty, so I run it one more time in this situation. P2 is the basic mode, but if I use another mode, out of 10, the detergent doesn't dissolve at all. The cleaning power seems to be the best in the basic mode, even if it runs for a longer time than the basic mode, the cleaning power is not as good as the basic mode. In the P2 basic mode, the detergent dissolves properly 2 out of 5 times. That's why I don't use the other modes. Even things like meat grease are clean after running it twice. And is there a mesh in the drain part? It can be separated from the machine, but no matter what I do, it won't come apart after I take it out. According to the manual, it seems to be separated, but mine doesn't. Still, it's not so bad that I can't wash it, so I'll just keep using it. But! The fact that it's almost half the price compared to other products is a huge merit. I recommend it to single-person households who are stressed out by washing dishes. You just have to turn it twice. If your partner is good at Tetris, he or she will like it if you give him or her a lot of praise. It even seems to be having fun later. I'm very satisfied just by being freed from the burden of washing dishes. Sam-ttang or El-ttang are twice the price for the same size, but if you give up a few convenient features, you can improve your quality of life at a low price. I understand why people buy Sikmo Sikmo. Now it's become an essential appliance.

Sentence (English): It's been about a week since I installed the product.
Comments (English): It's been about a week since I installed the product. I've used it every day for a week. I'm extremely satisfied! Reason for purchase: I used a dishwasher before, but back then, because the variety of detergents wasn't as extensive, I strongly believed that a manual dishwasher was better. Back then, I didn't cook much at home, so I didn't really see a need for one, and I wasn't particularly interested in the idea of a dishwasher. Now, I'm spending more time cooking and cleaning at home, and people around me have been raving about the convenience of dishwashers, so I've been researching them. I thought dishwashers within the same brand could vary based on performance, but when I first went to the store and looked at the different models, I was overwhelmed. Just like car options, the price difference could be as much as 200,000 won depending on what's included. I decided I needed to do some research before purchasing. Initially, I searched primarily for LG dishwashers and added them to my cart. The only model that seemed comparable to my Samsung 8575 was one starting with the number 4. The only difference was that the steam and drying functions could be used separately, but the price difference was quite significant. While it doesn't have as high a steam temperature as the LG brand, this model can also perform steam functions with its steam soaking and sterilization functions. Unlike this model, it also has a feature that allows for quick drying, but that's optional and not a requirement for a dishwasher, which is why I chose the Samsung brand. The installation process: The fact that it was said to be rocket-fast was a huge selling point for this product. I was hesitant at first, but once I decided, the fact that it could be installed quickly made it incredibly attractive. One thing to note here: For example, if a Samsung dishwasher is scheduled to arrive on the 20th, the technician who will be taking measurements before installation will arrive on the 20th. So, even if it says installation on the 20th, it doesn't mean it will be completed that day. I contacted Coupang customer service after purchasing, but they just kept repeating the same thing, making me sound like I couldn't understand. When I asked if the technician would come twice, they just kept repeating, "You can discuss it with the technician." So, I didn't feel like the installation process was very smooth. After installation, I used it. I saw on a search that many people had problems with drying on their Samsung dishwashers, so I was nervous and ran it a few times and tested it. After the automatic door opens, moisture naturally remains. Don't open the door in this state, but let it dry with heat. After a certain amount of time, if the dishes are placed correctly, they will dry well without any problems. Sentence (English): A week and a half ago our new dishwasher was installed, replacing a 17 year old Whirlpool dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ What a relief! ] || ---------------- || A week and a half ago our new dishwasher was installed, replacing a 17 year old Whirlpool dishwasher. We knew the old one wasn't doing a stellar job anymore, and we kept painting dishwasher "goop" over the rust spots on the rack . but holy cow! I had no idea HOW bad it was until we got this new washer! My filmy drinking glasses weren't suffering from hard water--just a bad dishwasher! Spots on everything? Soap residue on everything? Not normal! All issues are now gone and we get stunningly clean dishes that are "squeaky clean! " After a few years of "washing" our dishes before putting them in the old dishwasher, because of how poor a job it did, we are having fun putting in legit DIRTY, UNRINSED dishes and marveling at how ALL traces of food are GONE! (We're easily entertained! ) I wanted to be sure to have a new dishwasher in place before the holidays so I could feel confident about what my family would be eating off of. I'm so glad I did! We love the new-to-us 3-rack system. So far, we've made great use of the slim, top "flat" rack. The middle rack is adjustable (new for us), but so far, we haven't had to use that feature. Our large Tervis tumblers fit easily in the middle rack (too tall in the old top rack). The bottom rack has lots of height. My tea pitcher fits anywhere (old one, had only 1 spot I could put it and not hit the arm). The silverware basket has a sturdy flat bottom--no more tipping over for us while putting silverware away! And the individual silverware slots prevent nesting of spoons--another upgrade for us. Finally, it is SO, SO quiet! You can barely tell it's running. Sentence (English): This LG (Lucky Goldstar) was delivered and unpacked by a professional team arriving within minutes of their scheduled window time.
Comments (English): [ LG STUDIO STUDIO 24 in. PrintProof Stainless Steel Top Control Smart Dishwasher with 1-Hour Wash and Dry and TrueSteam. Super Quiet in our kitchen. ] || ---------------- || This LG (Lucky Goldstar) was delivered and unpacked by a professional team arriving within minutes of their scheduled window time. Since this was a replacement for my very noisy dishwasher, my needed preparation was minimal. My undersink water supply shutoff valve was only three years old so I was able to connect the new supply line without any effort. Note: Instructions say do NOT use teflon thread tape or anything except the brass fitting. My unit was hardwired so I was able to thread the power cable from the wall under the unit to the right front of the machine where the electrical connection bax is located and accessiblle from the front by removing two screws. The water connection was made on the lower left corner of the machine. The drain hose fit nicely on my current drain fitting was clamped with included hose clamp. The drain hose came clamped to the machine and is a telescopic ribbed hose which extends easlity and can be threaded from the machine into the cabinet side and routed so as to raised for anti-siphon purposes, with or without a siphon break. I have no garbage disposal.My cabinet space was such that I had a very minimal clearance so I had to be careful to make sure the heavy insulaation blanket did not get pulled out of place while sliding the machine into position. The machine is leveled by three leveling feet. The front 2 leveling feet are adjusted by a flat bladed screwdriver or a 1/4/” socket wrench. The read leveling foot is adjusted by turning a single screw at the center base in front of the machne.I ran the first test run with no leaks and the machine was very, very quiet. I had studied the manuals prior to receiving this machine and found the instructions to be clear and correct. Be sure to read them carefully and more than once to make for a smooth installation. I would monitor any outside installer/contractor to make sure they follow the instructions to the letter.My machine was delivered at 12:15 pm and I had the test run initialized about 3 hrs later with complete success. After two weeks of use, my wife is very happy. She states that this machine is very, very quiet.

Sentence (English): The best part is that it's incredibly easy to install.
Comments (English): The best part is that it's incredibly easy to install. A single woman could do it! Just attach two hoses and plug in the power cord. It's compact and fits perfectly where I wanted it, which is nice. The transparent window allows me to see what's inside, which is fun. My cat even watches it like it's watching TV. The fact that you don't pour water into the machine is a personal preference. Having to prepare a separate water tank is inconvenient, but I like that I can wash the water tank by hand. It's hygienic because I can see what's inside. The water cup washes cleanly even on high speed. The high speed and fruit washing functions are nice. However, when the door is open, the "OPE" light stays on. I'm not sure if it's because of the storage function, but I like to open the door for ventilation, and the light is a bit bothersome, which is the only slight drawback. Overall, I'm satisfied. Also, when it first arrived, the box was wet and there was a lot of water on the machine, which was a bit of a concern. I contacted customer service and they said it was because they tested it. For those who are surprised by water, please take note!

Since this was a replacement for my very noisy dishwasher, my needed preparation was minimal. Note: Instructions say do NOT use teflon thread tape or anything except the brass fitting. My unit was hardwired so I was able to thread the power cable from the wall under the unit to the right front of the machine where the electrical connection bax is located and accessiblle from the front by removing two screws. The water connection was made on the lower left corner of the machine. The drain hose fit nicely on my current drain fitting was clamped with included hose clamp. The drain hose came clamped to the machine and is a telescopic ribbed hose which extends easlity and can be threaded from the machine into the cabinet side and routed so as to raised for anti-siphon purposes, with or without a siphon break. I have no garbage disposal. My cabinet space was such that I had a very minimal clearance so I had to be careful to make sure the heavy insulaation blanket did not get pulled out of place while sliding the machine into position. The machine is leveled by three leveling feet. The front 2 leveling feet are adjusted by a flat bladed screwdriver or a 1/4/” socket wrench. The read leveling foot is adjusted by turning a single screw at the center base in front of the machne. I ran the first test run with no leaks and the machine was very, very quiet. I had studied the manuals prior to receiving this machine and found the instructions to be clear and correct. Be sure to read them carefully and more than once to make for a smooth installation. I would monitor any outside installer/contractor to make sure they follow the instructions to the letter. My machine was delivered at 12:15 pm and I had the test run initialized about 3 hrs later with complete success. After two weeks of use, my wife is very happy. She states that this machine is very, very quiet.

I called KitchenAid and this super expensive dishwasher only has a 1 year warranty. That's ridiculous. Also, you'll see a slit on the top left of the front door. That's where the steam comes out. It will begin to stain and look rusty. I will never buy a KitchenAid again and I recommend you don't either. If you really want this model, get the half price Whirlpool version. That way when it goes out, you'll only be losing half the money.

Comments (English): [ Do not purchase ] || ---------------- || There is only one thing wrong with this dishwasher, but it is so significant that it receives one star. The pros are, it cleans our dishes extremely well, it's quite, its clean and it has plenty of features that help with washing time and drying to name a few. The cons are the racks. The top rack for silverware is too small. You have to have the perfect layout for silverware to use it. Tongs, spatulas, serving utensils will not fit in the rack. So the more traditional utensil basket on the bottom rack is required. Unfortunately, those utensils mentioned are too long so, they must be positioned at an angle to prevent the upper washing spray arm from hitting them. Next, the second rack used for glasses and small bowls has a center bump that doesn't allow for dishes to sit securely. Too much time is invested in finding the best configuration for our dishes. Lastly, the bottom rack. This rack is the worst of the three and it is, in my opinion, poorly designed. The tines are too far apart and this causes issues for small plates and plates that are not perfectly round. The space between will cause issues with the bottom sprayers (hitting plates) In addition, the fold down tines are not secure. Plates of all sizes will cause the tines to fold over and break plates. With only four rows of tines, the space that it creates always has our dishwasher bottom rack not being used to its full capacity. I do not like this dishwasher and i wish i would have done more research to find the better one. In fact, all LG dishwasher racks are configured the same way. Do yourself a favor and find a dishwasher with additional bottom rack tines. This will provide more options for dish placement and less stress .

Sentence (English): In my house, the sink where I wanted to install it was non-standard (822mm) rather than standard (600mm), so I had to choose between calling a sink company or having the person introduced by the LG equipment technician, so I left it to the person the LG equipment technician introduced me to.
Comments (English): [ I installed it today ] || ---------------- || In my house, the sink where I wanted to install it was non-standard (822mm) rather than standard (600mm), so I had to choose between calling a sink company or having the person introduced by the LG equipment technician, so I left it to the person the LG equipment technician introduced me to. Yes. If you cut the existing sink and make a small 220mm cabinet, it costs 150,000 won instead of 200,000 won. If you just cover it, it costs 150,000 won. And if the power source is not under the sink, the cost of drilling from above costs an additional 38,000 won. Fortunately, we passed on this. They took the existing sink door, worked on it, and said they would install it in about 2 weeks. The sink is installed first on the same day, and the dishwasher technician comes and installs it right away, so it only takes one day. The washing machine is simple and pretty. When I asked the driver why this model was a little more expensive, he said that it was a newer model and better than the others because it included hot air drying. I chose it roughly without looking at the features in detail, but since it is a new model, I believe it has better features. If you are planning to purchase a dishwasher in the future, be sure to fill in the specifications sheet in the intended space when replacing the sink. Please note that if the drain pipe passes through the floor, you will not be able to place the dishwasher (I also changed the location of the new auxiliary cabinet) *After using it for about 15 days, I really like it. I regret why I didn't buy it sooner. I don't feel burdened when I take out a bunch of cooking utensils while cooking, and I don't get annoyed by my family when I come home from work and see a mountain of dishes piled up. Even if I collect it once a day and return it, it all goes in. And it cleans very well. The bowl is shiny. Even if you deliberately wash the inner container of the air fryer or the oily frying pan, it becomes clean. Don't worry
Comments (Original): [ 오늘 설치했습니다 ] || ---------------- || 저희집은 제가 설치 원하는 자리에 싱크대가 규격(600mm)아닌 비규격(822mm) 이라  제가  싱크대 업체를 부르든지  LG설비 기사님이 소개시켜주시는 분에게 하든지 선택을 하라해서 LG기사님이 소개시켜주신분에게 맡겼습니다.  기존 싱크대를 잘라서 220mm 작은장을 만들어 넣으면 20만원 아니고  그냥 가리기만하면 15만원이라네요.  그리고 전원이 싱크대 밑에 없으면 위에서 타공하는 비용도 38.000원 추가 듭니다. 다행히 저희는 이건 패스~~싱크대 문짝은 기존꺼 떼가지고 가서 작업해서 2주정도 뒤에 달아주신다고 들고 가셨습니다. 당일 싱크대 먼저 설치하고 바로 식세기기사님도 오셔서  설치해주니 하루만 시간내면 되네요.  세척기는 심플하고 이뻐요.  기사님께 이모델이  조금 비싼이유를 여쭤보니 열풍건조가 들어가있는 모델이라 다른거랑은 조금 더 신모델이고 좋다고하십니다.  제가 기능을 자세히 안보고 대충 골랐는데  신모델이라니  조금 더 좋은 기능이 들어있다고 믿습니다나중에라도 식세기 구입예정이신분들은 싱크대 바꾸실때 예정자리에 꼭 규격장을 넣으시고...  참 그자리에 배수관이 바닥에 지나가는 자리면 식세기 안치가 안되니  참고하세요 (저도 새로짠 보조장 위치를 바꾸었습니다)*보름남짓 써본 후기일단 너~~~무 좋습니다.  왜 진작 안구입했는지 후회됩니다.  음식할때 조리기구 마구마구 꺼내도 부담스럽지 않고, 퇴근해서 산더미처럼 쌓여있는 그릇 봐도 식구들한테 짜증이 안납니다. 하루에 한번 모아서 돌려도 다 들어가네요.  그리고  세척이 너무 잘됩니다. 그릇이 빤질빤질... 작정하고 씻는  에어프라이기 내부통이나  기름찌든 후라이팬 마구마구 돌려도 깨끗해져요. 고민하지 마세요

Sentence (English): Given my current space constraints, this was the absolute best choice, and I'm incredibly satisfied with it.
Comments (English): [ Given my current space constraints, this was the best choice I've ever made, and I'm very, very satisfied with it. In my case, I almost gave up on buying a dishwasher because the space around my sink isn't large. ] || ---------------- || Given my current space constraints, this was the absolute best choice, and I'm incredibly satisfied with it. Since I don't have much space around my sink, I'd almost given up on buying a dishwasher. Since I usually use a dish drying rack attached to the sink, I rarely use the drying rack on the left side of the sink, so I custom-assembled a marble top and used it as a countertop. But who knew it would be such a godsend? The round design of the Chefborn Washpole 4 makes it a perfect fit. There's no reason not to buy it! Of course, if space permitted, I'd have chosen a larger one with a stainless steel interior, considering its functionality and design. But since I was giving up on a dishwasher, I'm so happy I escaped dishwashing hell. A single friend of mine bought one after seeing mine. Highly recommended for single- or two-person households! And if space is limited, consider my experience. ^^
Comments (Original): [ 현재 공간 제한이 있는 상태에서 최고의! 최선의! 선택이었고 아주아주 만족하며 사용하고 있어요. 저의 경우 싱크볼 주변 공간이 넓지 않아서 식세기는 거의 포기하고 있었어요. 평소 ] || ---------------- || 현재 공간 제한이 있는 상태에서 최고의! 최선의! 선택이었고 아주아주 만족하며 사용하고 있어요. 저의 경우 싱크볼 주변 공간이 넓지 않아서 식세기는 거의 포기하고 있었어요. 평소 식기 건조대는 싱크대 부착식을 사용하고 있어서 싱크볼 내부 왼쪽 건조대는 잘 쓰지 않아서 대리석 상판을 맞춤으로 짜 올리고 조리대 등 여유 공간으로 사용해왔어요. 그.런.데 그게 신의 한 수가 될 줄 어찌 알았겠어요?! 쉐프본 워시폴4의 동그란 디자인 덕분에 바닥 넓이가 딱 맞는 거예요. 안 살 이유가 없잖아요! 물론 공간이 허락되었다면 크고 내부도 스텐으로 된 것들 중에 기능과 디자인 따져가며 구매했겠지만 식세기를 포기하고 있던 저로서는 설거지 지옥에서 탈출한 것만으로도 너무너무 만족해요.  제가 산 것을 보고 싱글인 친구도 바로 구매했답니다. 1~2인 가구 강추예요! 그리고 공간 안 되면 제 경우 참고하셔요. ^^

Sentence (English): On the plus side, this machine does a really great job of washing and drying dishes.
Comments (English): [ Great performance - with issues. ] || ---------------- || On the plus side, this machine does a really great job of washing and drying dishes. No complaints there. However, that comes at a cost. The rack materials are a bit flimsy, so the weight of heavy dishes causes the bottom rack to warp and the wheels to fall off their guides, dropping part of the rack into the basin, which interferes with the wash arm motion. The wash is not so good when that happens. There's a workaround: a couple of knives as shims to keep the wheels on the track, but that shouldn't be necessary. Also, the machine uses a newish technology to assist with drying. It works great. However, the wheels-off-the track problem likely dislodged a part on the pan, causing the pan to leak (just a couple of weeks outside of the warranty period). Bosch didn't even have the tools to make the repairs, so the dishwasher was out of service for several months while they fabricated them. Bosch ended up covering this repair, but it was all a huge pain. So, 5 stars for performance and 1 star for all the other baggage equals a 2-star review.

Comments (English): [ Noisy, flimsy tines & poor design ] || ---------------- || This machine does get the dishes clean and I like the interior light. But aside from that, I wish we had gone with a different brand. In a nutshell, the three biggest problems are: (1) it's LOUD, (2) the adjustable tines are flimsy and don't stay in place, and (3) the racks are poorly configured, making it impossible to load very much into the machine.This is the noisiest dishwasher we've ever had! (our last 2 were from Bosch and Kitchen Aid) We have an open concept kitchen/living area and we have to schedule the dishwasher to start after we've gone to bed because the sound is so distracting. We never had that problem with our previous dishwashers - in fact, we often couldn't tell if they were running. But with this one, everyone in the house knows when it's turned on! We bought it in large part because it's advertised as being extremely quiet - turns out that's completely untrue.The customizable tines are flimsy and mostly useless. They do not stay in place so dishes fall over whenever you move the racks. In fact, we had to tie some of the tines in the upper rack in place just so they would stay upright. We've broken several plates and glasses because of this problem (and it's not fun trying to remove shards of glass from the bottom of the dishwasher! ).The way the tines in the upper rack are positioned makes it almost impossible to load much into it. Yes, we've followed the instructions in the manual for how to load the dishwasher. And no, it does not work that way in real life! The way the upper rack is configured and the way the tines are positioned, you can only put a few bowls in it (unless they're very shallow bowls). If you try to put smaller plates in it, they roll toward the outside of the rack, leaving large areas where you can't put anything else in the rack. It's totally inefficient and extremely frustrating to load because things simply don't stay in place.I would recommend you look for a different model of dishwasher. This one was absolutely not worth the $1,000 price.

We bought it in large part because it's advertised as being extremely quiet - turns out that's completely untrue.The customizable tines are flimsy and mostly useless. They do not stay in place so dishes fall over whenever you move the racks. In fact, we had to tie some of the tines in the upper rack in place just so they would stay upright. We've broken several plates and glasses because of this problem (and it's not fun trying to remove shards of glass from the bottom of the dishwasher!).The way the tines in the upper rack are positioned makes it almost impossible to load much into it. Yes, we've followed the instructions in the manual for how to load the dishwasher. And no, it does not work that way in real life! The way the upper rack is configured and the way the tines are positioned, you can only put a few bowls in it (unless they're very shallow bowls). If you try to put smaller plates in it, they roll toward the outside of the rack, leaving large areas where you can't put anything else in the rack. It's totally inefficient and extremely frustrating to load because things simply don't stay in place.I would recommend you look for a different model of dishwasher. This one was absolutely not worth the $1,000 price.

Sentence (English): We've owned this model for a few weeks now and have run it a few times.
Comments (English): [ Much to Desire - Buy at own Risk ] || ---------------- || We've owned this model for a few weeks now and have run it a few times. Tbh we miss our 15 year old Kenmore dishwasher that broke down on us. It was larger with more capacity, dried dishes well, tines were evenly spaced and straight up, and door could stay open a few inches if needed. Worse complaint would be the bottom basket. The tines are all angled at a 75-80 degree angle and so close together which forces our plates to lean on each other and because of that angle my dishes scratch/drag/hit the outer tub walls when closing and opening lower basket. Super annoying. Old Kenmore washer tines were all pointed straight up so you didn't have this issue. Also, with straight tines you could load dishes smoothly and peacefully. Bosch design wasn't well thought out or designed for who knows who… maybe German dishes? We use the large correlle plates and it's just painful loading and watching the plates scratch and slide around when pulling out or pushing in the bottom tray. Also, door doesn't crack open a few inches if needed especially to allow the tub/dishes to dry. Everything comes out wet/damp even with the “extra dry” setting. I was pumped that they had 'special' drying tech since the machine doesn't use the heated coil to dry… but this alternative isn't so hot ( no pun intended).Also top tray didn't wash utensils well. Still had debris on a few. Wish they had installed another sprayer up top.Lastly, the utensil basket that came with it was short and small, about half the length of the basket. With it being so short, longer bigger utensils like a ladle, that don't fit the top tray will flop over. Luckily my old washer utensil basket fits so I was able to reuse that. Feels like getting ripped off. A $1,000 dollar machine that skimps out on these things, I am not impressed at all. Not sure what all the Bosch craze is only that maybe it's not made in China but Germany therefore ppl just feel better about that, but I don't think I'd buy another Bosch. I wish I didn't fall for all the positive reviews or positive fan crushing over Bosch. I actually wish I could return my unit, but local company doesn't accept returns after install. Super unfortunate.A few pros, machine is super quiet, middle rack works as expected and machine looks sleek. But those alone are not the purpose of a dishwasher. It's about how clean, how dry, how spacious and ease of use and dish loading. Thumbs down for sure.

Comments (English): [ So disappointed ] || ---------------- || Man. I am so disappointed in this dishwasher. We had the BEST kitchen aid dishwasher (it was from 2018) (254 model) it was wonderfully silent, large spaces inside for loading, the drawer in the top was FLAT and it was a dream. Sentence (English): Man.
Comments (English): [ So disappointed ] || ---------------- || Man. I am so disappointed in this dishwasher. We had the BEST kitchen aid dishwasher (it was from 2018) (254 model) it was wonderfully silent, large spaces inside for loading, the drawer in the top was FLAT and it was a dream. It finally gave out after 7 years so we wanted to stick with KA because we have been so pleased so we went with this one. The top drawer is shorter in length (the old one was the same length as the bottom drawer and now it's at least 2 inches shorter) - than our old one, the space holders of the rack where you lay bowls and other items are spaced further apart (so you can't stack bowls back to as well as I used to or anywhere near the same amount), not to mention you can't fit as many items like cups because it's shorter. I feel cheated and so disappointed with KA that this is the way they cheap out on things. I used to fit much more in a load than I can now , hence doubling my workload as a mom of 4 whose main job in life is loading and unloading the dishwasher. The drawer on the very top is shaped all wonky, so impractical with how they made it dip down in the middle and so shallow but too shallow to fit anything worthwhile. The top shelf used to be my favorite feature and now it's laughable how impractical it is. The worst part was that even though it lists the same decibels as our previous one, it's much louder. (Our old one you could only hear it when it started up) and this one I had to download a decibel tester on my phone and it got up to 60 at some points. You're losing us as customers, kitchen aid. We are returning this and going with another brand. I'm so sad as I loved our old dishwasher so much. Stop being cheap about things like drawer size, and taking away separators in both in the bottom and top racks. These are why people used to love your products. Because it went that extra mile to make life a little more convenient with the movable bottom for plate and pan sizes, or the extra little corner pocket that holds just a small amount of silverware. There was nothing "extra" here and in my opinion your run of the mill dishwasher.

Comments (Original): [ 조금 작지만 가성비 실속있는 식기세척기 입니다. ] || ---------------- || 맞벌이를 하다 보니 주로 배달음식이나 포장해서 식사를 많이 해결하는데... 저녁이나 주말에 가끔씩 조리를 해서 식사를 하다보면 은근히 그릇이 많이 나옵니다.  고민고민 끝에 식기세척기를 알아보다가 우연히 쿠팡체험단에 해당 식기세척기가 제공되어서 사용해 보고 솔직한 후기를 남기게 되었습니다. 처음 배달왔을 때 박스가 엄청 커서 조금은 놀랬습니다. 저희 아파트는 5층이라 엘리베이터가 별도로 없어서 배달해주시는 기사님이 엄청 고생하셨구나 하는 생각이 들어서 죄송하면서도 감사했습니다. 부피가 큰 만큼 무게는 크게 나가는 편은 아니었습니다. 1. 일단 문 손잡이가 수동식이고 자석으로 되어 있어서 손으로 열고 닫아야 합니다. 조금은 힘을 주고 쌔게 열도 닫아야 하는 점은 감안을 좀 해주셔야 합니다.  2. 3인용이다 보니 안쪽 공간이 그렇게 넓지 않습니다. 그래서 후라이팬이나 부피가 큰 접시, 그릇은 별도로 설거지를 해주셔야 합니다.  3. 자동급수 형태가 아니고 수동급수로 해야 하며 물 5리터를 채워야 작동이 가능합니다. 물론 만수시 소리가 나는 점은 좋았습니다만 자동급수가 아닌점은 조금은 번거로운점 있습니다. 그리고 전용세제로 사용하셔야 합니다. 일반 주방에서 사용하는 퐁퐁 넣으시면 거품 늘어나고 난리납니다.  4. 초벌 세척은 해주시고 넣어주셔야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 막혀서 청소를 해주셔야 합니다.  5. 물 주입시 넘쳐서 흘러내리는 경우 잘 닦아주셔야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 에러코드가 발생됩니다.  6. 소음은 조금 큰 편이라 너무 늦은 밤에는 사용하지 않기를 권고드립니다. 미디어라는 중국 브랜드를 옛날에 사용해봤는데 많이 발전했다는 느낌도 받았습니다.  모든 상품에는 장점과 단점이 혼재하지만 그래도 가격대비 이 정도 품질이면 만족스럽습니다. 2~3인 용으로 대가족이 같이 계시는 곳에서는 사용하기 힘들고 신혼부부/자취하시는 분/애기젖병 세척 및 소득 등의 용도로 사용하신다면 강력히 추천드립니다. 특히 좋은점은 무타공으로 자가설치가 가능하다는 점 입니다. 혹시나 미디어 전기 식기세척기를 알아보고 계신다면 제 상품평이 조금이나마 도움이 되었으면 하는 바램으로 상품평을 마치겠습니다. 제 상품평이 도움이 되었다면 하단에 \'도움이 돼요\' 버튼 클릭을 부탁드립니다. 감사합니다. *** 이 상품은 쿠팡 체험단 이벤트로 선정되어 무료로 제공받아 사용해보고 작성한 상품후기 입니다. *** 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ It's a small dishwasher, but it's cost-effective and practical. ] || ---------------- || Since both of us work, we usually eat out or order takeout. Comments (English): [ This is amazing :D ] || ---------------- || I live alone and work, and for my health, I try to eat as many side dishes as possible when I eat on the weekends. I always peel and eat fruit after eating. After using it, I was amazed by the new world where the rice bowl, soup bowl, tumbler, plate, ladle, scissors, spoon, and water cup are automatically washed at once. Wow! I even feel a sense of deprivation(?) as to why I used to wash dishes one by one by hand with detergent on a dishcloth. While the dishwasher is running, I can study, shower, read the newspaper, or even go out for a bit, so it’s amazing! Sentence (English): This was my first brand new washer (and the accompany dryer as a set) I purchased back in May 2023.
Comments (English): [ Washes well, quiet, and great deal! ] || ---------------- || This was my first brand new washer (and the accompany dryer as a set) I purchased back in May 2023. I did my research, read reviews, and ended up buying the washer (and dryer) on sale for what I felt was an amazing deal! I was looking for something that fit within my budget, was easy to use, and would allow me to wash my clothes. They were delivered exactly on time. I didn't realize how much could fit within the drum! It's just me at home, so it's quite big. However, I love that I can wash blankets, comforters, and pillows easily! I have dogs, and can wash all of their items in one load. There are a variety of settings to fit your needs, but one that I would have liked to see if an efficiency or quick wash type of setting, as the minimum time to wash is about 38 or 40 minutes I believe. My old washer from the had a 30 min. automatic sensor wash cycle that was economical, as it tailored the water to the load, and was great for smaller loads. Still, I've had no problem washing my clothes, both detergent and the pods work well, and my clothes come out clean. I think this is great for families, as the drum is big in my opinion. When the cycle ends, it plays music, which I love because I know it's done. One thing to be mindful off is when washing towels, blankets, pillows, etc.: make sure to balance the stuff inside the drum. I had issues with a few blankets that got stuck to the side and I had to run the cycle a few times because it just stopped. It happened twice but never again afterwards.

Comments (English): [ Almost too quiet ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher is great. Lots of added features and a great layout for my needs. The cutlery drawer is my favourite, but I also like the adaptable layouts at the bottom. Pros: Silent Cleans well Great internal spacing Fits all dishwasher tablets in easily. Door opens itself when completed to let me know it's finished washing and drying. (It's too quiet for my household so I can never tell if its still going.) Cons (all insignificant, but I thought I'd add): Inlet hose has an additional bulky section which needed the cupboard holes to be increased to fit through to the tap on installation. Too many programming options. I'm not the type of person to use 10 settings. Seems a little overkill for my needs. Eg: WiFi! Doesn't come in white. It's silly, but this model would look better in my kitchen in white. The silver is still great. Too musical. It has silent or sound option, but the sound is too long and musical so we've had to put it on silent. At least it has the option to mute. Side note: Installation needs a little more detail than just plug and play, but not much more. There are rubber stickers to attach and the felt pieces need to stay on for now reduction. Also, the connection inlet has that chunky extra piece to account for. Running it the first time is confusing but once you've found your ideal setting, it works beautifully. I have very tall glasses and some tall plates so the adjustable shelf heights are brilliant. If you're looking for a machine that Cleans well, is adjustable, and is super quiet. This is the machine for you.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher worked great for about eight uses.
Comments (English): [ Quit cleaning after about eight uses ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher worked great for about eight uses. Then it threw a trouble code of 4C, a problem with the water supply. Nothing had changed. I checked that the drains are clean, water heater is working, supply line is open with no kinks. I reset the dishwasher by turning off the power to it and still got a 4C code several minutes into the wash cycle. I restarted the wash and it went through a complete cycle with no codes, however the dishes were still dirty, with the dishes in the top rack completely unwashed. I have tried going through additional wash cycles with the same results. Samsung product support is useless, as they just reiterate what is in the manual. After researching online, the most likely culprit is a faulty water inlet valve in the dishwasher. We had bought this dishwasher along with a refrigerator and range during a remodel of our kitchen. Due to setbacks on cabinets these appliances sat in the garage for several months. My wife and I usually don't use the dishwasher for just the two of us so the dishwasher was out of warranty when it decided to break.

Sentence (English): In 1994 my wife Jenny and I decided that for my 50th birthday we would shout ourselves a kitchen reno, and promised ourselves to install top quality appliances instead of the cheapies we had been putting up with since our marriage in 1968.
Comments (English): [ One more time .  ] || ---------------- || In 1994 my wife Jenny and I decided that for my 50th birthday we would shout ourselves a kitchen reno, and promised ourselves to install top quality appliances instead of the cheapies we had been putting up with since our marriage in 1968. Among our choices was a BOSCH SMS5012AU/11 Dishwasher made the year before (birthday, that is.) We could not have made a better choice; it gave 30 years faultless service with replacement of only one tableware basket until earlier this year when it started failing to complete a full wash/dry cycle. A call initially to Australia's customer service department led us to a consultant (who happened to be in London) and who advised us that the mdel wasn't even on the database and asked for more info. On receipt of our purcahase date she looked up an old database and found it - please our name, address and purchase details. Impressive, hey? But unfortunately, spares were no longer available so service might be a bit tricky - after 30 years? We thought 'Well, fair suck of the sauce bottle, what's available now to replace it? A relo recommendation and web search took us to E & S Trading and the BOSCH SMU6HCS01A that we've installed ourselves, thanks to the simple instructions. (The prior installation wasn't an impediment, we'll admit. Had there not been a branchline already from the adjacent sink water supply we may have needed a plumber.) Now there it sits in all its glory, washing (and drying) our dishes, pots, pans, oven liners, champagne flutes, you name it, even the dog's bowl, perfectly. Happy? We sure are! Recommend a BOSCH? Sure do!

Sentence (English): As a renter in a small NYC apartment, space for our family is already at a premium.
Comments (English): [ This Apartment-Sized Dishwasher Saved Our Marriage ] || ---------------- || As a renter in a small NYC apartment, space for our family is already at a premium. We have limited countertop space, floor space, and wall space. So when we realized that handwashing our dishes wasn't very water efficient and also meant having a drying rack taking up an entire counter, the switch to a dishwasher was a very attractive option.And what an upgrade! This 800 Series model is both ideal for apartment living and provides plenty of room inside for a day's worth of dishes for a family of four. Instead of contending with a pile of dishes in the sink and even more drying on the counter, we can enjoy the entire kitchen with space to breathe. It's not an exaggeration to say this dishwasher truly saved our marriage! The 800 Series is quiet enough to be a background hum with most loads (only really makes noise when a dish is placed inside that's moving around), connected seamlessly to our water outlet during install, and gets everything clean and dry with the recommended Finish products. No wonder it makes the NYTimes Wirecutter list. We give it ten out of ten squeaky clean plates!

Sentence (English): (This review was received through a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ Good Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (This review was received through a promotion.) Good machine, many functions such as steam which very few have, silent, and the lower arm rotates in both directions to better reach all spaces, but without a doubt what made me opt for this dishwasher was the energy classification type A, it is almost the only one that has it and supports hot water which improves energy efficiency. It is curious that appliance sellers are unaware of this point (that it supports hot water) even in some stores when asked they did not know how to answer. The mobile application is more for diagnosis and to see the status of the machine than for programming, since it does not allow you to activate or deactivate functions. It is one of the few that can be integrated with a sliding door, and once integrated, it is neither seen nor heard, it projects a beam of light on the floor to know that it is working
Comments (Original): [ Buen Lavavajillas ] || ---------------- || (Esta reseña se ha recibido a través de una promoción.) Buena maquina, muchas funciones como el vapor que muy pocos lo tienen, silencioso, y el brazo de abajo gira en los dos sentidos para llegar mejor a todos los espacios, pero sin duda lo que me hizo decantarme por este lavavajillas fue la clasificación energética tipo A, es casi el único que la tiene y admite agua caliente lo cual mejora la eficiencia energética.Es curioso que los vendedores de electrodomésticos desconozcan este punto ( que admite agua caliente) incluso en algunas tiendas al preguntarlo no sabian que contestar.La aplicación para el móvil, es mas para diagnostico y ver el estado de la maquina que para la programación, pues no te deja activar o desactivar funciones.Es de los pocos que se puede integrar con puerta deslizante, y una vez integrado, ni se ve ni se oye, proyecta un haz de luz sobre el suelo para saber que esta funcionando

Sentence (English): I quickly decided on the Bosch after reading just a few reviews and what can I say, it was the right decision.
